entries.postTitle: How to Tell When Something Is Not for You Anymore

captions.threads:
1/4 there's a specific tired that sleep doesn't fix. you do the thing. you do it well. people literally tell you you're lucky to have it. and yet. something in you is quietly screaming that this doesn't fit anymore. which makes you feel ungrateful, which makes the whole thing worse.

2/4 here's what nobody tells you: alignment isn't about happiness. it's not about passion or motivation or any of that. it's about whether the thing you're doing is still asking you to be someone you're not. whether you're contorting yourself smaller to fit into a space that used to work. whether you're explaining away red flags because leaving would mean admitting you outgrew it.

3/4 the crazy part? sometimes the thing is genuinely good. it just stopped being good for you specifically. at this particular point in your becoming. and that's not failure. that's not ingratitude. that's evolution trying to tell you something that your rational brain is too busy defending against.

4/4 the real question isn't "should i stay or go." it's "who am i becoming and does this still serve that person." everything else is just noise. vibrationofawesome.com/blog/boom/posts/how-to-tell-when-something-is-not-for-you-anymore

entries.postTitle: Signs Your Life Is Misaligned

captions.threads:
1/4 You're doing everything right. The apartment is clean. The work is solid. People think you've got it together. But there's this frequency underneath it all, this hum that doesn't match. Not depression exactly. More like wearing someone else's life as a costume that fits just well enough to fool everyone, including yourself sometimes.

2/4 The misalignment whispers before it screams. It shows up as restlessness you can't name. As projects that should excite you but feel hollow. As the growing distance between what you're building and what actually makes you feel alive. You keep adding more productivity, more discipline, more good choices, wondering why the signal isn't getting stronger.

3/4 Here's what I've learned: alignment isn't about getting your life organized better. It's about whether your actual daily moves match the frequency you're actually tuned to. Are you building what you actually want to build, or what you think you should want? Are you with the people and projects that genuinely light you up, or are you performing competence in a life that doesn't belong to you?

4/4 The quiet inside you isn't a bug. It's information. It's showing you the gap between where you are and where you need to be. Not where you think you should be. Where you actually need to be.
